params.description: If passed, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is passed) or Variable/Field reference (if * is omitted).

params.name: direction
params.description: 0 or omitted = list of previous URLs, 1 = list of next URLs.

params.name: titlesArr
params.description: Array of window titles corresponding to urlsArr.

discriminatedBy.rule: Text (an object name) when the leading * is passed; Variable or Field passed directly when * is omitted.

constraints: titlesArr can only be requested if direction is also passed (it is nested inside direction's optional group in the doc signature).
